name: Agriculture
blurb: Crop type, field boundaries, and condition from field to national scale.
useCase: A food-security analyst mapping cropland to target aid before a lean season.

name: Disasters
blurb: Rapid damage assessment and event extent for response teams.
useCase: A humanitarian responder scoping flood extent in the first 48 hours after a storm.

name: Water
blurb: Surface water, flooding, and hydrology monitoring.
useCase: A basin authority tracking seasonal water extent and flood risk.

name: Forestry
blurb: Species, structure, canopy height, and deforestation.
useCase: A carbon-project verifier attributing forest loss to a driver over a concession.

name: Urban & Land Use
blurb: Land cover, settlements, and built-up structure.
useCase: A city planner updating an informal-settlement map for service delivery.

name: Infrastructure
blurb: Buildings, roads, industry, and the built environment.
useCase: A logistics planner extracting road networks where basemaps are stale.

name: Maritime
blurb: Vessels, marine debris, and coastal monitoring.
useCase: A fisheries agency flagging dark vessels and drifting debris.

name: Defense & Security
blurb: Object detection, change, and activity monitoring.
useCase: An analyst detecting new construction or aircraft across wide areas.

name: Climate, Carbon & Energy
blurb: Cryosphere, emissions proxies, and renewable-energy assets.
useCase: A climate-finance team siting solar and tracking glacier retreat.

name: Biodiversity & Ecosystems
useCase: A conservation NGO mapping habitat extent and change.
